admission.justification: Spans all nine independent registration modules across the public tool surface and is guarded jointly by test_role_tool_scope.py (<= 500 raw chars and per-role byte ceilings) and test_tool_descriptions.py (normalized bounds and doc pointers).

applicability: Applies to all 44 PUBLIC_TOOLS declared across the nine tool-registering modules under mcp/src/agents_remember/mcp/registration/.
conditions: Every ordinary registered tool's raw description length is at or below 500 characters while preserving all pinned contract substrings, AST docstring shapes, and documentation pointers.
exclusions: Does not govern the four explainer-surface tools in explainer_tools.py or external documentation files under docs/.
statement: All 44 PUBLIC_TOOLS across the nine registration modules advertise optimized raw descriptions at or below 500 characters while preserving every pinned contract substring, AST docstring shape, and documentation pointer.
